definitions.explanation: Saying too much, claiming more than is true. Almost only used in the set phrase 〜と{言|い}っても{過言|かごん}ではない, "it is no exaggeration to say ~", which introduces a strong claim.

examples.japanese: {決|けっ}して{過言|かごん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It is by no means an exaggeration.
It is no exaggeration to call him a genius.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{過言|かごん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧だろう。
examples.english: It would be no exaggeration to say that this invention changed our lives.

notes:
Made of {過|か} (excess) + {言|げん} (words), with the reading ごん. A formal word, common in speeches, essays and news commentary.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{過言|かごん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: it is no exaggeration to say ~
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{過言|かごん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧だろう: it would be no exaggeration to say ~
